title: spec(contracts): `AuthSessionApi.getSession` claims to declare every field its readers read, but its result declares three; readers cast to read `session.id`, `token`, `user.email`, the auth gate and `impersonatedBy`
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b): a declared contract the code contradicts. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, from the dev report on #22270 (PR #24194). ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's.

Seam: spec:AuthSessionApi.getSession result → runtime:resolveAuthzContext session arm (packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts) | runtime:print door impersonatorOf (packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.ts, PR #24194)

**Reader who acts:** the spec lane (`packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`), one dev round. The readers then read the declared fields without casts.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` for "AuthSessionApi getSession return type declares only user id session readers read undeclared fields": 1 hit, #22384, closed `completed`. That was the INPUT half (`query.disableRefresh`). This card is the RESULT half.

## What is on `main` (`727091c821`)

- **The contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`, `export interface AuthSessionApi`, about `:358`). Its docblock, verbatim: "What is declared is exactly the input the in-process readers send and exactly the fields below that they read. Widening this is for whoever needs more, with the call site to prove it." The result declares `user?: { id?: string }` and `session?: { userId?: string; activeOrganizationId?: string }`, and nothing else.
- **What the readers read beyond that** (read by the seat on `main`, `resolveAuthzContextInScope`'s session arm):
  - `sessionData?.session?.id` (the session row id, for the dropped-claim log line);
  - `sessionData?.session?.token` (`ctx.accessToken`);
  - `sessionData?.user?.email`;
  - `normalizeAuthGate(sessionData?.user)` (the ADR-0069 auth-gate fields on the user).
- **And one more once PR #24194 lands:** `session.impersonatedBy`, read by the print door's `impersonatorOf` to refuse a print from an impersonation session. That PR reads it through a cast because its dispatch held `packages/spec` out of scope.
- **Why it matters:** each undeclared read is typed `unknown` or through a cast, so a field better-auth drops or renames on an upgrade compiles cleanly and reads `undefined`. For `impersonatedBy` that turns an impersonation refusal off silently, in the fail-open direction. PR #24194 is asked to commit a real-boot pin for its own read; this card makes the contract say what is read.

## Wanted

- `AuthSessionApi.getSession`'s result declares the fields its in-process readers read, each optional, with the reader named:
  - `session.id`, `session.token`, `session.impersonatedBy`;
  - `user.email`;
  - the auth-gate fields `normalizeAuthGate` reads.
- The readers drop their casts.
- If a field turns out not to be read by any reader, it is not declared.
- `Clause-②: yes` (a declaration widening), with its contract review.

Dedupe words: AuthSessionApi declared fields, getSession return type, impersonatedBy session field, in-process session read contract.
